premises: Silicide coating (Si-20Cr-20Fe) can be applied to MoNbTaTiW RHEA by fused slurry method
Coating forms a duplex structure (outer oxide, inner silicide) that acts as a diffusion barrier
Coating significantly reduces oxidation of MoNbTaTiW RHEA at high temperature
Protective mechanism involves formation of continuous, dense silicide/oxide scale
Effectiveness is demonstrated under isothermal air exposure at elevated temperatures
